_comment: Where product photos come from. `npm run photos -- --all` runs every source; add a new web shop here or pass it on the command line (--woocommerce URL --provider Name). "browser": true opens Google Chrome to download (for shops behind Cloudflare's browser check, which refuses plain downloads); without it Chrome is opened only if the shop blocks the direct download.

sources.note: WooCommerce Store API; the product SKU equals the code in JCH's price list. Behind Cloudflare -> downloaded through Chrome
Steel's price list carries a FOTO and a FICHA URL per product (ingested as photoUrl / sheetUrl)
